hypothesised_pattern: The base model overpredicts when |x4| is small and |x5| is large, and underpredicts when |x4| is large, which points to a missing even effect of x4 (and possibly a negative even effect of x5).
functional_form_guess: difference of even terms, e.g. a*(1 - exp(-x4**2)) - b*x5**2/(1 + x5**2)
rationale: Eight negative residuals have |x4| <= 0.66, and most of them have |x5| >= 1.06 (up to 2.29). The two positive residuals have the largest |x4| (-1.00 and 2.12), consistent with an even, sign-independent x4 effect that the base model cannot represent.
